say: First time in Vietnam? Ten things to know.
title: 10 THINGS
sub: to know on your first trip to Vietnam

say: Crossing the street? Walk slow and steady. The bikes flow around you.
title: Cross slow & steady

say: Carry cash. Street vendors rarely take cards.
title: Carry cash

say: Lots of zeros: a hundred thousand dong is under five dollars.
Get the Grab app for rides and food.
title: Get the Grab app

say: Eat where the locals line up.
title: Eat where locals eat

say: Bargain at markets, with a smile.
title: Bargain with a smile

say: Cover shoulders and knees at temples.
title: Cover up at temples

say: Never stand chopsticks upright in rice.
title: Chopsticks: never upright

say: Say, sin chow, for hello. And, gahm un, for thank you.
title: Xin chào · Cảm ơn
